meta.title: Afonso Silva | Full-stack developer
meta.description: Afonso Silva is a full-stack developer in Madeira, Portugal, working with .NET, Vue and Nuxt. Former professional musician.

hero.name: Afonso Silva
hero.pitch: I build web software with .NET and Vue, from Madeira. I still listen like a musician.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: I spent years as a professional musician, where timing and listening were the whole job. I still hear most things as a mix: every part needs room, and nothing should be louder than it has to be.
Today I'm a full-stack developer, mostly with .NET and Vue. I like software that is clear to use and calm to maintain, and I enjoy the rare projects where audio and code meet.

items.title: Website + custom CMS
items.summary: The public site and the content management system behind it, built with Vue 3 and .NET.
A website designed and built end to end in Vue.
Personal headphone mixes for RME TotalMix FX, controlled from each musician's phone through a QR code. Runs as an offline desktop app.
